cam.spec: A flat cam, one solid, 10 mm thick (z 0..10). Its outline is the closed polygon (straight lines) through the 72 points at angles θ = 0°, 5°, 10°, ..., 355° (measured from +X towards +Y), each at distance r(θ) = 40 + 8·sin(3θ) mm from the origin. A 12 mm diameter bore goes through it along Z, centred on the origin.

bestfit.spec: These 10 points (x, y in mm) were measured on the round edge of a boss: (35.757, -3.91), (15.942, 18.429), (5.029, 17.623), (-10.729, -0.026), (-4.348, -21.343), (15.994, -27.855), (19.084, -27.121), (22.454, -25.848), (28.63, -21.453), (31.025, -18.809). Make the boss: one cylinder along Z from z 0 to 15 whose circle is the best fit through the points: the centre (cx, cy) and radius r that minimise the sum of squared distances from each point to the circle (geometric least squares). Round cx, cy and r to 0.01 mm before building.

table.spec:
A base plate 120 (X) by 80 (Y) by 3 mm, spanning x 0..120, y 0..80, z -3..0, as one body. On it stand cylindrical standoffs, each a separate body (not joined to the plate), standing on z = 0 along Z, centred at (x, y) with the height and diameter from this CSV table:

optbox.spec: One solid block with its minimum corner at the origin, (200 − 2x) mm long in X, (120 − 2x) mm wide in Y and x mm high in Z, where x is the value that makes the block's volume as large as possible. Round x to 0.01 mm before building.

terraces.spec: One solid made of 10 blocks side by side along X: block k (k = 0..9) spans x 10k..10k+10, y 0..30 and z 0..h_k, where h_k = 20·e^(−0.3k) + 5 mm, rounded to 0.01 mm. The blocks are joined into one body.

beam.spec: A cantilever beam of square cross-section s × s mm, 200 mm long along X: x 0..200, y 0..s, z 0..s, one solid. It is aluminium (E = 70000 N/mm²) and carries an end load P = 500 N. Use the smallest s, in whole millimetres, for which the tip deflection P·L³ / (3·E·I), with I = s⁴/12, is at most 1 mm.
